(NOTIFICATIONS) New message + appointment + progress update create client notifications; push relay failures (401 to integrations.emergentagent.com) are logged as WARNING non-blocking (expected — placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY). Frontend (390x844 mobile): /setup renders setup-screen + setup-done card, /mein-projekt login screen shows NO setup-hint; admin login (DEMO_PASSWORD) works; Admin > Mehr renders with more-media/more-cms/more-portfolio/more-notifications; Medien screen has media-upload-images button (thumbnails render as red placeholder in headless — minor); CMS at /admin/list/cms exposes cms-key chips (brand/hero/services/about/katharina/process/faq/contact/announcements), cms-img-logo/logo_dark, cms-save; Benachrichtigungen shows push-action-required ACTION REQUIRED card about google-services.json; Portfolio > portfolio-new opens inline form with pf-cover + pf-photos; admin project detail /admin/project/{pid} > admin-project-tabs-Fotos > admin-add-before-after opens sheet-before-after with all fields: ba-pick-before, ba-pick-after, ba-title, ba-desc, ba-zone, ba-date, ba-visible, ba-published, ba-submit; client chat /client/chat/{pid} exposes chat-connection, chat-list, chat-attach, chat-attach-doc, chat-input, chat-send. rca_of_issue: Bug RCA: POST /api/media returned 500. Backtrace showed AttributeError at routers/files.py:129 (`f.content_type = ctype`). Starlette >=0.28 made UploadFile.content_type a read-only property backed by `headers['content-type']`, so direct assignment raises. The code needed to override content-type for .glb/.gltf uploads (Starlette can't infer them from mimetypes). Fix: thread an optional `content_type` argument through routers/crm.store_upload() and pass the computed ctype from upload_library. This preserves the .glb/.gltf mapping without mutating an immutable property. Verified: POST /api/media with 1x1 PNG returns 201 kind='library'; GET /api/files/{id} without auth returns 200 image; test_library_public_readable now passes.
